my_file_tools module¶

My useful file tools

my_file_tools.get_parameter_regexp(filename, parameter_to_fetch)[source]¶

Using regular expression, fetch the value of a parameter used in the simulation from the logfile Might be overkill, but it should withstand changes in the logfile layout.

Parameters:
  • filename (String) – Name of the logfile
  • parameter_to_fetch (String) – Parameter to look for in the logfile
Returns:

parameter_value – Value of the parameter fetched in the simulation logfile
Return type:

float
my_file_tools.save_fig_as(path, filename)[source]¶

Joins automatically the path and the desired filename to save the current figure

Parameters:
  • path (string) – Path to the directory in which the figure should be saved
  • filename (string) – Desired filename for the saved figure
Returns:
Return type:

Nothing
